rules.text: Bots only interact with bots of their own department. Skip upstream changes that widen peer, room or Chief reach across departments, and their tests.
Skip upstream onboarding, welcome flow, app tour and first-launch card changes, and their tests, docs and translations.
Skip upstream visual redesign changes: fonts, type and radius scale, chat styling, bubble and theme colours. Their bug fixes in the same area still get triaged on their own.
Skip the upstream Set me up button and everything wired to it: setup-request routes, setup offer on the greeting, composer chip, companion routes for it.
